title: 삼공이 열쇠
suno_analysis_sp: K-Indie folk ballad. Acoustic guitar plays a steady fingerstyle pattern with alternating bass notes and arpeggiated chords. A clean electric guitar provides melodic counterpoint with light chorus and reverb. The bass guitar enters with melodic, legato lines. Male vocals are delivered in a soft, conversational baritone. The tempo is 72 BPM in 4/4 time, in the key of G Major. The arrangement is sparse, focusing on the interplay between the fingerpicked acoustic guitar and the vocal melody.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[fingerpicked acoustic guitar]

[Verse 1]
[soft baritone male vocals]
버스에서 내렸다
시골이었다
여관을 [clean electric guitar enters]
찾았다
간판에 불이 반만 들어
왔다
안에 들어갔다
주인이 열쇠를
줬다
[bass guitar enters]
카드키가 아니었다 쇠열쇠였다
나무 열쇠고리에 삼공이라고 적혀
있었다
